promised_definitions.a_current_bar: docs/beta-bar.md 'Which documents' + docs/corpus-expansion.md section 14: a document is promised unless README.md disclaims its kind (refused scans/forms/>250pp; dense journal papers with equations; slide decks, brochures, posters; heavily designed layouts of the SSA-statement kind; CJK, RTL and other non-Latin/Cyrillic/Greek scripts; scans with an OCR layer). Designed InDesign reports of flowing text, annual reports and IRS/GPO multi-column booklets are read as promised, as holdout-1 read h04, h14, h32-h34 and h37 (with h37's flag on the section-14 y61/y13 precedent).
promised_definitions.b_narrowed: (a) minus the design classes designed-report, annual-report and multicolumn-booklet (IRS/GPO/Federal Register style), which become Not yet. Resumes, ordinary Word/Google Docs/LaTeX documents, long flowing-text reports and Chrome web prints stay promised.
